desc: The Bergara BMR-X Steel is the ultimate rimfire rifle for competitive shooters and precision plinkers. Its heavy #6 profile steel barrel provides the stability and weight needed for steady, consistent shots, making it ideal for rimfire series competitions. The BXR-inspired stock offers an adjustable length-of-pull, vertical grip, and flat forend, providing the same ergonomic feel as Bergara’s full-size precision rifles at a more accessible price. With the reliable Bergara Micro Rimfire action, included 30 MOA rail, match chamber, and externally adjustable Bergara Performance Trigger, the BMR-X Steel is designed to deliver competition-level performance for shooters who demand the best in accuracy and affordability.
